entries.title: A card opens after you come back to Infinitary on an iPhone or iPad
entries.body: When you came back to Infinitary on a busy iPhone or iPad, a card you had opened could show "This card stopped responding" before it had started. Infinitary now waits until the card has started before it checks it. A card that really stops answering still offers Retry.
entries.noPicture: The fix removes a wrong message; the card itself looks as it did before.
